description: Zernike O(0)+d(2) fit with constrained vs full per-frame poses

zernike_constrained_poses.pose_model: shared R + shared XY + per-pose Z
zernike_constrained_poses.notes: Optimal intermediate: flexible enough for optics, constrained enough to stay physical

zernike_full_poses.notes: Absorbs noise + pose errors → less physical rayfield, harder for compact model to fit

telecentric_on_zernike_full.notes: Zernike full-pose rayfield is LESS physical — harder target for compact model

telecentric_direct_corners.notes: Intrinsic limit of 14-param compact model. 7 px gap vs Zernike is the cost of physical interpretability.

conclusion: Constrained-pose Zernike is the optimal intermediate observable. Zernike full-pose absorbs too much noise, making rayfield identification harder. Telecentric plateaus at ~7.6 px direct corner fit — this is the genuine calibration performance of a physically-motivated compact model.
